projects.title: Call Intelligence: Voice Analytics Pipeline
projects.summary: Enterprise-grade multi-region batch & streaming Medallion Lakehouse pipeline processing 200K+ daily Amazon Connect voice transcripts across 5 global regions.
projects.description: Engineered an end-to-end data pipeline on Databricks & Delta Lake that ingests, cleans, enriches, and structures massive Amazon Connect Contact Lens voice transcripts into queryable analytical tables across 5 global business regions (EU, NAM, LATAM, APAC, MEA).
projects.architecture: Amazon Connect S3 Raw ➔ Databricks Auto Loader (Bronze) ➔ PySpark Structured Streaming with CDF (Silver) ➔ Business Aggregations & Sentiment Quartiles in Delta Lakehouse (Gold) ➔ Unity Catalog Governance
highlights: Engineered 3-tier Medallion architecture (Bronze ➔ Silver ➔ Gold) on Databricks & Delta Lake
Implemented PySpark Structured Streaming with Delta Change Data Feed (CDF) & version watermarking
Extracted sentiment quartiles, talk-to-listen ratios, and customer experience metrics with schema drift protection
Enforced centralized access control, table lineage, and secret management using Unity Catalog

projects.title: RentSlate: Tenant & Rent Management Platform
projects.summary: Mobile-first web app for landlords to manage properties, rooms, tenants, monthly rent & electricity billing, payments, ledgers, and PDF receipts — built to be simple enough for non-technical users.
projects.description: Production-ready multi-role rental management platform (Owner, Manager, Tenant portal) backed by Supabase Postgres with full Row Level Security. A pure, unit-tested billing engine mirrors server-side Postgres functions so balances, credits, and carry-forwards stay consistent client- and server-side.
projects.architecture: React 19 + TypeScript SPA ➔ TanStack Query ➔ Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Storage, RLS) ➔ Postgres Billing Functions & Triggers ➔ Edge Functions (WhatsApp / Email Bills) ➔ GitHub Pages CI/CD
metrics: Row Level Security on Every Table
highlights: Monthly billing engine combining rent, metered electricity, late fees and automatic debt/credit carry-forward
Dated rent revisions, room transfers and move-out settlements without ever overwriting historical bills
PDF receipts, UPI QR payments, WhatsApp/email bill delivery, ledgers, reports and CSV export
Installable PWA with dark mode and large touch targets designed for elderly, non-technical landlords
